hotspots.title: Tech‑Sector Visa Attack
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has suspended tech giants Microsoft and Adobe from green card and foreign worker programs over alleged H-1B abuse and labor fraud. Administration officials and VP J.D. Vance explicitly framed the aggressive actions as protecting American workers from corporate displacement.
hotspots.affect: This story drives intense economic nationalism and outrage by pitting American white-collar workers against major tech corporations accused of systemic foreign labor abuse.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Blitz
hotspots.blurb: President Trump is executing a high-tempo midterm campaign blitz with rallies and motorcade appearances across Texas, Nebraska, Maryland, and scheduled stops in New York and Alaska. Local coverage highlights massive crowd turnout, local economic promises, and direct endorsements of congressional allies.
hotspots.affect: Commands heavy attention by generating triumphalist campaign momentum and electoral urgency across nationwide right-wing media outlets.

hotspots.title: Immigration Enforcement Crackdown
hotspots.blurb: Federal immigration rhetoric and enforcement actions have escalated sharply, led by President Trump urging Minnesotans to 'fight back' against Somali immigrants. Simultaneously, reports reveal over 500 U.S. citizens detained during federal sweeps while federal judges step in to block $1.8 million fines levied against migrants.
hotspots.affect: Exhibits maximum affective polarization driven by anti-immigrant threat framing, citizen detention alarms, and escalating executive-judicial legal clashes.

hotspots.title: Higher Education Federal Crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is pursuing punitive actions against higher education institutions, including visa fraud investigations into nine universities and court battles to strip Harvard of federal funding. Additional measures include suing the University of Delaware over undocumented student tuition and proposing $70,000 fees on international student work authorizations.
hotspots.affect: Taps directly into right-wing culture-war hostility against higher education, treating academic institutions as adversarial targets requiring strict executive discipline.

hotspots.title: Frp Populist Surge & Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (Frp) and leader Sylvi Listhaug reached an unprecedented record high of 31.9% support in national polling. However, the landmark political surge is accompanied by public disputes over 1.7 million NOK in payouts awarded to party leaders and debates over local energy and transport failures.
hotspots.affect: Combines a historic polling triumph for right-wing populism in Norway with sharp media scrutiny over internal financial leadership payouts.
